name: task
description: Chat-first task workflow: grill the plan one question at a time, then capture the discussion at the depth you pick — to-task / to-plan / to-roadmap / to-spec, never a flag — into a Markdown artifact under .task/. No execution skill — any session told to implement the artifact follows its stamped Execution block to a commit, then hands that diff to the plugin's own code-reviewer agent, which proves every finding before fixing it, runs your project's build and tests, and amends the commit. 6 skills plus one reviewer agent — grill is a pre-capture interrogation that writes nothing, and roadmap-to-workflow is a thin dynamic-Workflow wrapper, not hand-rolled orchestration.
